name: @epoch/desktop
description: Epoch desktop client (W017): the typed reference implementation of the desktop host shell — the window/session model, the versioned content-addressed host↔shell envelope seam (the IPC contract a native wrapper backend carries), the full-fidelity desktop DeviceDescriptor (W011 slot), experience mounting through W012 compiled artifacts into W013 renderer invocations (admitInvocation-enforced, never bypassed), foundation-backed authoring projections (typed proposals, zero shell authority), and content-addressed offline/session caches with freshness/invalidation records. Pure typed data: no native bundling, no engine, no UI-framework dependency; the future native shell embeds this contract.
